quotes.text: It's not a replacement for teams or SharePoint. Think of it more like a hub that connects them.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Positions Loop workspaces clearly relative to Teams and SharePoint.

quotes.text: Take a task list from your Loop page, turn it into a component, and paste it into a Teams chat or an Outlook email that component keeps a live connection to the original.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains in one sentence what makes Loop components unique.

quotes.text: Assign a task to someone and it automatically appears in their Microsoft to do right in their personal task list alongside their grocery list and reminders.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concrete illustration of the task sync between Loop and To Do.

quotes.text: Loop works best for informal collaboration, brainstorming, and lightweight project management. It's great for fast-moving work where things change day to day like a project kickoff, a campaign planning session, or a weekly stand-up tracker.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear guidance on when Loop is the right tool.

quotes.text: Think of Loop as the glue. It brings together all the short-lived fast-moving pieces that normally get scattered across different tools.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable metaphor summarising Loop's role in Microsoft 365.

chapters.title: Tasks synced with Planner and To Do
When to use Loop vs. other tools

takeaways: Loop workspaces act as a digital project room that brings notes, tasks, files and conversations for one project into a single shared space.
Loop components stay live wherever they are pasted, and Loop task lists sync automatically with Microsoft To Do and Planner.
Use Loop for informal, fast-moving collaboration, and keep OneNote, SharePoint, Word and Excel for personal notebooks, formal libraries and formal documents.
hook: Your notes are in OneNote, files in SharePoint, tasks in Planner and conversations in Teams, and every switch costs focus. This episode explains Microsoft Loop workspaces in plain English for anyone running projects in Microsoft 365. You will learn how workspaces, pages and components fit together and when Loop is the right tool.
